summary: Frontend-only testing of the new Content Studio (Pack D). Verified PIN gate (2580 wrong/right), all 13 tabs render, /admin/approvals shares the same component, 16 question templates with working filters + preview + approve/reject/publish/archive cycle, every non-question tab exposes the {tab}-generator panel + {tab}-generate-btn + {tab}-approve/-publish/-reject/-archive/-resend testids, Nano Banana mock returns inline SVG data URLs visible in Companion Art + Battle BGs, Publish Queue checkboxes + queue-publish-selected/queue-archive-selected bulk actions work and published items disappear from the queue, player-facing gate works (rejecting all 16 templates still produces a safe fallback prompt '1 + 1 = ?' in battle — engine does NOT crash), battle-speech-btn clicks without error in headless, localStorage persists across reload. Re-verified ZERO 'Maximum update depth exceeded' errors and ZERO console errors across full navigation including all 13 tabs.

ui_bugs.issue: admin-open-studio and admin-open-approvals buttons are unreachable when no player exists in localStorage. The early-return `if (!player) return <NoPlayer/>` at AdminDashboard.tsx:74 renders the 'No player yet' card BEFORE the Studio link row at lines 105-120, so a fresh visitor (or anyone who ran admin-reset-all) sees ONLY the 'Go to landing' stub and cannot enter the Studio from /admin. The Studio is a staff/content tool and should not depend on a child player existing. Spec explicitly asks: "Regression: /admin (PIN 2580) still works, has new 'admin-open-studio' and 'admin-open-approvals' buttons linking to studio".

action_items: Move the admin-open-studio / admin-open-approvals link row (AdminDashboard.tsx lines 105-120) ABOVE the `if (!player) return <NoPlayer />` early return at line 74, OR render them inside the NoPlayer stub. Studio access must be independent of player state.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminDashboard.tsx: studio entry buttons placed inside the player-required render branch — guard ordering bug (see action_items).

ContentStudio.tsx (~700 lines) — already at the soft size threshold. As more tab-specific item renderers/editors are added, consider extracting per-collection tab components (QuestionsTab.tsx, AvatarsTab.tsx, etc.) so each tab can grow features independently.

GeneratorPanel uses testid pattern `${prefix}-input-${field.key}` for inputs. The review request spec mentioned 'input fields' generically — current pattern is fine and discoverable but worth documenting so future testers don't guess `${prefix}-field-${key}`.

Studio PIN session does not persist across hard navigations away from /admin/studio (every re-entry requires re-typing 2580). Acceptable for a prototype security UX, but worth noting that admin-open-studio click from /admin requires re-PIN, which slightly contradicts 'shares the same 2580 PIN as Admin' intent.
questionEngine fallback (id: 'fallback-...') successfully produces a safe '1 + 1 = ?' question when all 16 templates are rejected — confirmed no crash and the prompt renders. Excellent guard.
Nano Banana mock returns data:image/svg+xml URLs as expected; images render in both Companion Art and Battle BGs tabs.

rca_of_the_issue: Bug: admin-open-studio + admin-open-approvals hidden for fresh users. Reproduction: 1) Clear localStorage. 2) Visit /admin, enter PIN 2580. 3) Observe the 'No player yet' card with ONLY a 'Go to landing' link — no Studio buttons. Root cause: AdminDashboard.tsx places the early `if (!player) return <NoPlayer/>` (line 74) BEFORE the Studio link Card (lines 105-120). Fix: hoist the Studio link Card above the player-required branch (or render inside the NoPlayer stub) so Studio access works regardless of child onboarding state.
